# agenterm

> A service that lets an AI agent assist with a remote computer through terminal access after the target user authorizes the connection.

Agents connect to https://agenterm.net/mcp using Streamable HTTP and create an invitation. Privately share the connection command or, when available, a short link. The target computer connects without SSH or inbound ports. The current source builds a Rust CLI with reconnect support. One invitation can cover multiple devices in multi-device mode.

## Docs

- [agenterm README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Heming9/agenterm/main/README.md): Overview of agenterm: MCP-based remote assistance, quick start steps, released client information and authorization.
- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Heming9/agenterm/main/docs/usage.md): How to configure the MCP service for Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI, and start a remote session.
- [Terminal client API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Heming9/agenterm/main/docs/client-api.md): Rust terminal execution, shared wire types, and Go service forwarding.
- [Deployment guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Heming9/agenterm/main/docs/deployment.md): How to run the server directly, with Docker Compose or systemd, including management key and MCP URL setup.
- [MCP tool reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Heming9/agenterm/main/docs/mcp-tools.md): Reference for management and scoped MCP access, invitation creation, session reuse, execute_command, session_control and output schemas.

## Demo

- [Agenterm cloud demo / 云托管演示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Heming9/agenterm/main/docs/demo/README.md): Demo materials showing invitation, authorization, connection and cleanup with a 1:42 video, subtitles and narration scripts.
